name: Anaplan
summary: Anaplan is a connected-planning platform with workforce and headcount expense planning for large finance and HR teams. Its pages describe position plans tied to the financial budget and unlimited what-if scenarios on salary, benefits, reporting lines and location. It publishes no prices and routes buyers to a demo form.

facts.text: The workforce planning page promises continuous position planning aligned with the financial budget and lists optimizing headcount and position plans as a goal.
The headcount expense page describes modeling what-if scenarios across multiple variables, with headcount changes, terminations, transfers and merit increases as examples.
The headcount expense page mentions dashboards that track variance to budget and tools for business unit finance partners to create and justify staffing cost requests.
The pricing page shows no prices or plans and sends visitors to a form to reach an Anaplan expert.

plans.name: Anaplan
plans.notes: No prices published. The pricing page offers a form to reach an Anaplan expert and a personalized demo
